BY PP, ASSAM Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. M KALITA Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  BEFORE
THE HON'BLE MR JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY
Heard Mr. M Kalita, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Ms. RH Bora, learned Additional PP, Assam.

This is an application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. praying for granting regular bail to the petitioner, Md. Samir Ali, who was arrested on 13.08.2023 in Page No.# 2/3 connection with Bihpuria PS case No. 143/2023 under Sections 120(b)/420/406/392/34 IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Investigation is almost over and statement of accused has thoroughly been interrogated by the investigating agency.
There is no legal evidence against the present applicants to connect them with the alleged offence.

The learned Counsel further submits that the applicant is in Md. Samir Ali vs The State Of Assam on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163498849/
1 custody since 13.08.2023 and the conclusion of trial will take sufficient time.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the aforesaid grounds, prayer is made to release the applicant on bail.
Learned Additional Public prosecutor for the state has seriously opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Looking at the facts and circumstances of the case and on a perusal of the material available on record and also the advance stage of investigation and period of detention, this Court without commenting anything on the merits of the case is of the opinion that no further custodial interrogation/ detention is required.
Accordingly, the present application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur with the following conditions.

(1) The petitioner shall not hamper with the investigation, or tamper with the evidence of the case, (2) The petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with Page No.# 3/3 the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer, (3) The petitioner shall appear before the I/O on each and every date as and when called for.
Bail application stands disposed of.
